notes: Today is now one box with five parts: Reading and labs, Quiz, Coding track, Interview practice and Coaching, with a summary at the top.

Each part has its own minutes each day (change them in Profile › Plan): interview practice and coaching now share 30 minutes on weekdays and 45 at weekends, instead of growing with every new question.

Unfinished work moves to the next day inside its own part, newest first. An earlier module's unfinished reading shows first in its own block; last week's unsolved problems wait for the weekend instead of mixing into this week's set; a mock's unanswered questions open the next mock on the same module.
